reasoning: SNS1(outline 10.2)是 SNS 章的統攝句:navigation widget 讓使用者「快速」啟動到特定地點的路徑。與 066-01「按下已設定的 shortcut 會啟動路徑」高度相鄰,必須劃清界線,否則構成重複測項。界線取在規格用的「quickly」:062 驗的是可達性——從 Home Screen 的 Shortcuts widget 單次按壓即可啟動,途中不需先進入 Navigation 應用程式或任何中間選單;066-01 驗的是按壓後路徑確實啟動。因此本條的 ER 著重「未經任何中間畫面」與「仍停留在 Home Screen」,而非路徑本身的正確性。這是 framework.md Part I 記錄過的抽象葉節點模式(A-001):抽象敘述的可測內容由鄰近具體條文承擔,本條只保留自己獨有的那一面。優先級:屬 navigation shortcut 的核心價值主張,訂 P1(路徑實際啟動的 P0 由 066-01 持有,不重複計)。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 062 asserts one-press reachability from the widget; 066-01 asserts the route actually starts

tcs.test_item:
The system shall implement Navigation Quick Start: SNS1.) Navigation widgets allow the user to quickly start a route to a specific location.

(Navigation shortcut pressed from the Home Screen -> the route starts directly, with no intermediate screen and without leaving the Home Screen)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. A Shortcuts widget is placed on a Home Screen page
3. A navigation shortcut to a saved location is set in the Shortcuts widget
4. No route is active
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that contains the Shortcuts widget
2. Read the navigation shortcut displayed in the Shortcuts widget
3. Select the navigation shortcut
4. Read the screen displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the Shortcuts widget is displayed
2. The navigation shortcut is displayed with the location set in it
3. A route to that location is started without any intermediate selection screen being displayed
4. The Home Screen page remains displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_10.2
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
